CarPlay starts as soon as Bluetooth is ready
settings.description: The CarPlay app starts when Bluetooth is ready (about 30-40 s after power-on) instead of at the end of startup (about 47 s), so the phone connects up to 10 s sooner.

settings.title: USB drives and hubs don't start wired Android Auto
settings.description: A hook in the Android Auto app (no files changed). Without it, a USB drive can block wireless Android Auto until the head unit restarts.
